tasks.label: B - Compiler et tester le backend (Maven)
C - Demarrer backend (sans Docker)
tasks.command: $env:JAVA_HOME=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('JAVA_HOME','User'); $env:Path=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User')+';'+[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine'); docker compose -f docker-compose.full.yml down; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File start-all.ps1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\start-all.txt

tasks.label: D - Installer dependances et demarrer frontend
tasks.command: $env:JAVA_HOME=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('JAVA_HOME','User'); $env:Path=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User')+';'+[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine'); npm.cmd install *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath ..\logs\npm-install.txt; npm.cmd start *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath ..\logs\npm-start.txt

tasks.label: 0 - Tout lancer avec Docker (backend + frontend)
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "docker compose -f docker-compose.full.yml build *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\docker-build.txt; docker compose -f docker-compose.full.yml up -d *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\docker-up.txt; docker compose -f docker-compose.full.yml ps *>&1 | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath logs\docker-up.txt"

tasks.label: 0b - Etat et journaux Docker
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "docker compose -f docker-compose.full.yml ps -a *>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs\docker-ps.txt; docker compose -f docker-compose.full.yml logs --no-color --tail 80 *>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs\docker-logs.txt; Get-Content logs\docker-ps.txt"

tasks.label: 3 - Tester API
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\test-api.ps1 -Sortie logs\api-tests.json | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\test-api.txt
